title: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter
responsibility: Execute exact-model Claude Code or Codex CLI module tasks, exposing public results and structured quota rejection without transporting provider keys.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.constructor.execute
inputs.description: Optional process executor for CLI calls; when omitted, the adapter uses taskProcess to launch the selected provider command. The documented default is the source expression taskProcess, evaluated by the implementation; it is not a literal string value.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command.selection
inputs.description: Provider, exact model and intelligence level used to build that provider's CLI argument vector.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Provider selection plus the task working directory, prompt and abort signal needed to execute and cancel one CLI run.

inputs.name: taskProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable and argument strings for the selected provider CLI, launched as one admitted task process.

inputs.name: taskProcess.input
inputs.description: Run context supplying the selected provider and model, child working directory, prompt for stdin and signal for cancellation.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command
outputs.description: Argument vector for the selected provider CLI, including its model, effort and output settings.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected task identity, public response text and reported model after CLI events pass success and identity checks.

outputs.name: taskProcess
outputs.description: Resolves with the child CLI exit code and captured stdout after the admitted process closes; stderr is discarded.

errors.name: ModuleTaskRunError
errors.description: Signals a failed provider run, quota rejection, denied tool permission or a CLI model different from the requested selection.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by run when a non-empty line of the CLI's stdout is not JSON. It is raised before the result is read, so it carries no usage or reportedModel.

errors.name: TaskOutputOverflowError
errors.description: Rejected with the message 'Task CLI output exceeded its bound.' when the CLI's stdout passes 8,000,000 characters; the process group is killed first.

errors.name: AbortSignal.reason
errors.description: input.signal's reason (a DOMException named AbortError unless abort() was given another reason) when the signal is aborted before the CLI starts or while it runs; an abort kills the CLI's process group first.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: The spawn error when the CLI cannot be started, for example ENOENT when claude or codex is not on PATH.

errors.name: resourceWork rejection
errors.description: Rejections from resourceWork while it reserves the 2048 MiB coding slot pass through, for example 'Resource queue is full', a wait timeout, 'Resource request exceeds usable capacity after reserves', or a SyntaxError from an invalid queue config.json.

errors.name: ModuleTaskRunError
errors.description: Thrown, with usage and reportedModel attached, when the CLI exits non-zero, reports no result or an error event, Claude's quota was rejected (quotaRejected is then true), Claude was denied a required tool, or the CLI ran a model other than input.model. Any other Error raised while reading the result is rethrown with the same two fields.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by run when a non-empty line of the CLI's stdout is not JSON. It is raised before the result is read, so it carries no usage or reportedModel.

errors.name: Executor rejection
errors.description: Rejections of the injected executor pass through unchanged; with the default taskProcess these are the abort reason, TaskOutputOverflowError, the spawn error and resourceWork rejections.
